name: Zoutelande
info: Steep dune, about 45m tall, good lift in light winds. Takeoff only possible from the top of the dune.

Due to the steepness and height of the dune, there is an extreme wind gradient at Zoutelande. The wind will be much stronger than forecasted at the top of the dune, and there may be no wind at all at the beach. Only attempt to fly in strong winds if you are an experienced pilot and very confident in your groundhandling. In light winds, try to lose as little altitude as possible on launch, and stay close to the terrain.
No takeoff from the bottom, small and crowded takeoff at the top, only really suitable for experienced pilots with good ground handling.
Large thorny trees behind the takeoff. Be careful and avoid getting swept behind the dune at all costs.

name: Castricum aan Zee
info: Steep dune, almost 20m tall. Good lift in light winds, but difficult to climb for launch. It is easier to climb the less steep dunes closer to the entrance to the beach.
At the steeper dunes, the wind gradient can make it so there's very little wind down at the beach.
Can get crowded on weekends and holidays.
Strandhuisjes during Summer. Be prepared to walk quite some distance to reach dunes not blocked by them, avoid flying near them if possible.
Beware of thorny bushes at the top of the steeper dunes.

info: Very turbulent with more than around 15deg left crosswind, due to the presence of wind turbines upwind.
Very small site that can get very crowded. If possible, avoid on weekends and holidays.
